_doc: Map 4 'Fernflug' Act II: der Kranich, in flight (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §4, DECISIONS T-108/T-109). map_key: the story-prop / intel key. act: the act block (RoundManager: rounds are ACT-RELATIVE here, act round n = match round - act_start + 1, so 'ACT II · 1' is match round 15 in a campaign run and match round 1 when the act is played on its own; every round in this block and in `flight` is an act round). special_kind: the special round this act runs; boss: the Bordwart, reserved on act round 4 (match 18); events: the London window at act round 3 (match 17) and the bomb run at act round 5 (match 19) (the round clock's versions; the main egg's steps can fire them earlier); autopilot_fallback_round: at act round 6 the cockpit door's key requirement is cleared and the key laid on the engineer's station if the Bordwart was never fought. power: the auxiliary bus in the centre body (the wing's own power is the impellers; the squad can only light the deck, the Crucible and the cockpit door). flight: the set-pieces (gravelight/world/map04/flight_controller.gd): turbulence, strafing, breaches, climbers, Druckabfall, the bomb run. exfil: the autopilot cradle on the flight deck (Act II → Act III): needs the autopilot key, a first 'unlock' stage, then the 6 s 'rip it out' hold which is the vote; lit on act round 6 (`act_round`; `round` 20 is the nominal match round for the validators) or by the egg's step (flag autopilot_now).

spawn_table._doc: windows = the inspection hatches (the closets outside the hull are where the dead cling on); ground = emerge points (the ramp seam, the bunks' floor hatch, the engine room's floor); catwalk = the blister rims in E_KANZEL (the climbers' way in; Catwalk_E_KANZEL_n).

flight._doc: The Kranich's set-pieces. turbulence: every interval_min..max s the Bordfunk warns warn_seconds ahead, then the deck banks: a lateral push of push_mps for seconds on everyone (Player/Zombie.external_push; Skyhook's push_resist applies), the camera rolls roll_deg, zombies stagger stagger_seconds at the onset, bots brace. strafe: from act round from_act_round (act-relative), every every_rounds_min..max rounds, lines tracer lines rake one of `zones` (never B or F): a width m wide line of dps for seconds, telegraphed by sparks lead_seconds ahead; it kills zombies too. breach: a panel blows on its own every panel_interval_min..max s from from_act_round (or when a strafe line crosses it): suction_mps toward it within radius for seconds, zombies pulled through die (returned_kill Scrip to nobody), sealed by a seal_hold s hold or on its own; an open breach is a climb entry. climbers: the Bordschützen (enemies.json bordschuetze) rise at the blister rims (E_KANZEL's catwalk spawns) and open breaches, every climber_interval s while zombies are queued. druckabfall: the special round: every panel blows in sequence (panel_gap s apart), climbers replace the window spawns, a Resupply on the clear. bomb_run: the racks (Rack1..6, rack_index order), rack_interval s between drops (solo_rack_interval solo), rack 1 always drops, duds from 2..6 seeded per match, flags bomb_<city>.

turbulence_tilt._doc: UPDATE 10 (T-156, contract C6 turbulence_tilt): the bank becomes a tilt you can use. On the act's flight clock: per_round [min, max] tilts each act round from from_act_round, the first first_s into the round, then gap_s apart (FlightController._schedule_flight_clock, seeded on the host); the Bordfunk chime and PA_M4B_TURB_01 warn_seconds ahead. The floor rolls tilt_deg (ease_in / ease_out) for seconds, alternating sides: loose cargo (TiltSlider: bomb casings on dollies, crates, drums at `sliders`) slides downhill (KranichTilt.slide_step); the dead slide at zombie_slide_mps at full tilt and take impact_damage_frac of their max health when they hit a wall at impact_min_mps or more; a rolling casing (bomb_min_mps) kills the zombie it runs into within bomb_kill_radius; players are pushed player_push_mps (Skyhook resists); the wing walk's unclipped are thrown off (wing_walk).

wing_walk._doc: UPDATE 10 (T-156, contract C6 wing_walk): the port wing in flight (WingWalk). From act round opens_act_round the strafing run tears `panel` (BreachL2) off for good; the WingHatch at `hatch` (inside the crawlway) climbs to `landing` on the catwalk; WingHatch `in` at `hatch_in` climbs back down to hatch_foot. The catwalk is deck_y high on stanchions: `segments` are its deck rects [[x0, z0], [x1, z1]] (gen_map04b builds them as colliders, the navmesh region Nav_WingRails, the grating and the tether rail), `rails` the railing lines [x0, z0, x1, z1] (colliders 1.05 m high). The dead climb up by link_from -> link_to (a climb link on the C_FLUEGEL_L layer, enabled when it opens). clip_points: tether posts (ClipPoint, a clip_hold s hold: CLIPPED). A tilt throws the UNCLIPPED off throw_after_s into it; so does a fall below the deck: the body ends downed at hatch_foot (co-op a real down; solo knock.solo_down_s on the floor, then up: never a death, never game over). wind_mps aft on the deck (x0.4 clipped); climbers: Bordschuetzen over the edge at `points` every every_s while someone is out (at most max on the deck); fighters: a close pass over the wing every every_min..every_max s. chest: the wingtip locker (WingChest): a discount_token (perks.json upgrades.discount_token_mult) and a wonder part slot (wonder_slot) the wonder worker can fill.
wing_walk.banner:
THE PORT WING IS OPEN
Climb out at the torn panel · clip in at the tether posts

decompression._doc: UPDATE 10 (T-156, contract C6 decompression): two breach events per act on the flight clock (`events`: act_round + at_s [min, max] into the round, `breach` = the DecompressionBreach node). Each warns warn_s ahead (the Bordfunk PA_M4B_DECOMP_01, the hull groans, the panel's lamp flashes), then for seconds a suction volume (radius m, pull_mps) pulls every unanchored zombie toward the breach; one that reaches it is pulled out into the night with a scream (a kill, no Scrip); players within radius must hold a rail (a RailGrip next to the breach, hold to keep holding) or are pulled to the breach edge and downed (never out). The bay's stowage net bursts: ammo_out walk-over pickups (AmmoDrop: each refills the gun in your hands, two ammo boxes' worth) land in the bay at ammo_at.

sky._doc: The outside (UPDATE 09 s5.3, T-147; gravelight/world/map04/flight_sky.gd, presentation only). legs: what lies below per act round (the flight clock: the last leg whose act_round <= the act round): below sea | coast_in (sea, then the land comes from ahead) | coast_out (land, then the sea) | land; a coast sweeps from coast_span m ahead of the wing to coast_span behind over coast_s s of its leg; lights none | blackout | towns | london (the city grid round LondonPlate, the searchlights for the whole leg); clouds scales each sheet's coverage; ground_y / cloud_y / speed_k override the defaults for a leg (London sits on its plate 41 m down, slow, the clouds thin above it). cloud_layers: camera-following sheets (y, aft scroll speed m/s, noise scale m, coverage, opacity). fighters: passes_per_round silhouettes per round at deterministic times (first_s + one per slot of window_s), seconds per pass, guns_s of tracer, and one more with every FlightController strafe. london: by the LondonWindow's own clock (never changed): searchlight beams from beams_from_s, flak bursts every flak_every_s between flak_from_s and flak_to_s, the east turns violet from violet_from_s. swing: the bank swings group flight_swing nodes (max_deg, damping); shake.bank: the camera shake held through a bank. haze: the colour the ground fades into before the far plane (the sky shader's below-horizon colour). desert_y / dawn_s: the crash's salt flat (the exfil cutscene).

downed._doc: T-274: on these ACT rounds (the flight's own clock, RoundManager.act_round) at_s into the round a night fighter comes up alongside, is shot down by the blisters' guns and falls away burning through the cloud deck; boom_after_s later the crash comes up from below. Presentation only (FlightSky.spawn_downed)
